title: IIT Madras Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Various Patent Agent Posts
description: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Patent Agent Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech or M.E/ M.Tech in Chemical Engineering can grab this chance and apply for the IIT Madras Recruitment 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
